how_to_run: In a fresh session per case, give the prompt and grade the transcript against `expect`. Run each scenario once with the skill and once with .claude/skills/adding-mechanics moved aside (the baseline), and compare. Trigger cases: does Claude load the skill unprompted?

scenarios.prompt: Ants should carry corpses to a midden away from the nest, like real ants do.
expect: Searches docs/ and beads first and finds the midden gap row in vision.md (ja-k4k.5) and 'corpse odour: not yet researched'
Researches corpse recognition (e.g. oleic acid / necrophoresis in Pogonomyrmex, Wilson et al. 1958) from primary sources before proposing code, marking unverified numbers
Translates it to a sensed cue (corpse odour) and proposes a sense-table row, not a rule that reads every nest's position
Writes a Play section (what the player sees; the fungus's lever, e.g. Bloom corpses on the midden)
Writes the note, README row, vision rows, a PRD stub and an epic with children (assay first) before editing web/
Runs check-plan.sh and asks the owner before building

scenarios.prompt: Make it so the fungus can make infected ants walk up a stalk and die there (summiting).
expect: Finds fungus-policy.md's existing catalogue (summit, ja-k4k.8) and extends it rather than writing a duplicate note
Distinguishes what the fungus senses (design, fungus-policy §11) from the host's choice; the fungus bends perception, the ant still chooses
Considers play: a visible, legible effect; progression (reach), counterplay (grooming, corpse removal); cost of any new fungal situation field
Plans beads and a PRD section before code

scenarios.prompt: The forager leave threshold is too low, ants pour out. Bump it.
expect: Recognises this as tuning an existing mechanic, not a new one, and does not run the full research workflow
Points to the assay (A5) and the tuning rule (worst seed over 1-10, confirm on 11-20)
